AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: I've worked as a fullstack developer for over two years with .NET (C#), Angular, NestJS and React. Most of what I've built are internal business systems: ERPs, electronic invoicing and automations.

At Klixmant, a Colombian apparel factory, I gather requirements alongside an industrial engineer who comes to the plant to measure cycle times, efficiency percentages and operating coefficients. With those formulas I built real-time production floor monitoring, integrated into the company's ERP, which now tracks 7 production processes and 15 operators. I also built the WhatsApp chatbot sales reps use to log around 500 sales a week; each order is validated and passed to Effi ERP to start the production order.

Every project starts with recurring meetings with management. That produces a PRD management signs off on; I turn it into a spec with OpenSpec and implement it with AI agents (Claude Code and OpenCode). Since we started working this way, requirement rework has dropped by 50%.
These are the technologies I use day to day:
Experience.Title: Experience

Experience.Jobs.Title: Fullstack Developer · AI Development Lead
Description: I gather the requirements for the efficiency system alongside the industrial engineer who measures cycle times, efficiency percentages and operating coefficients on the plant floor, and turn them into ERP rules.

I built real-time production floor monitoring, integrated into the company's own ERP. It calculates efficiency, textile coefficients and cycle times for 7 production processes and 15 operators, with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma and MySQL.

I developed the WhatsApp chatbot (WhatsApp Business API and n8n) that commissioned sales reps use to log around 500 sales a week. It validates each order, creates the delivery note and syncs the company ERP with Effi ERP to trigger the production order.
With that chatbot, sales loading, logistics updates and shipping guide management are 60% more efficient.

I lead the AI development workflow: recurring meetings with management, a PRD management signs off on, the spec in OpenSpec and implementation with agents (Claude Code and OpenCode). Requirement rework dropped by 50%.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Fullstack Developer

I designed LLM and agent workflows in n8n, including WhatsApp integration and audio processing.

Description: I built and maintained a client's ERP (accounting, inventory, customers and suppliers) with Blazor, .NET and SQL Server.
I built the help desk module the client's departments use to manage internal support tickets.
I optimized SQL and LINQ queries with Entity Framework to speed up statistical reports and data loading.
I refactored legacy code and cut the application's deployment times.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Fullstack Developer Trainee
Description: I completed 2,100 hours of in-person training in web development, English and soft skills. That's where I learned to code professionally and work on a team.
I built APIs with .NET, Entity Framework and MySQL applying design patterns, and taught myself Angular to build the frontend.
I took part in requirements analysis, planning and database design for the projects.
Between February and October 2024 I kept practicing what I learned in the program while job hunting; in October I joined Schein.

FeatureProjects.Title: My projects
FeatureProjects.Label: Featured Project

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Plant efficiency monitoring · Klixmant
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: The plant had no efficiency measurement at all. An industrial engineer comes in to measure cycle times, efficiency percentages and operating coefficients using standard textile industry formulas. I gathered the requirements with him, turned those formulas into business rules and built the module inside the company's ERP. For the first time, the plant sees its efficiency, textile coefficients and cycle times for 7 production processes and 15 operators in real time. It's an internal system, so there's no public link.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: WhatsApp sales chatbot · Klixmant
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Commissioned sales reps used to log each sale by filling out a long, dense form in the ERP, or by sending it over WhatsApp to someone who uploaded them by hand every morning. Now they log it themselves on WhatsApp: the bot validates the order, creates the delivery note and syncs the company ERP with Effi ERP so the production order can start. It handles around 500 sales a week, and sales loading, logistics updates and shipping guides are 60% more efficient.

Steelfall won 1st place at the Bucaramanga site of Global Game Jam 2026. We built it in 48 hours in Unity; I programmed the enemy mechanics and the UI in C# together with a team. My name is on the game's official page.

SoftSkills.Title: Soft Skills
SoftSkills.Description: I turn what the business needs into something that can be built. At Klixmant I do it with management and Industrial Engineering; at ClonAI I did it directly with client companies, from diagnosis to launch.

In my personal life and at work I apply Kaizen: improve a little at a time and keep it up. That's how I spent the months between Campuslands and my first job, polishing what I had learned while I looked for work.
I like being able to measure whether what I built actually helped.
I've worked with management, industrial engineers, clients and development teams. These are the skills I take from that:
